endpoint.description: Base URL of the BridgePort instance, e.g. `https://bridgeport.example.com` (no trailing slash). May also be set with the `BRIDGEPORT_ENDPOINT` environment variable.

token.description: API bearer token used to authenticate. A scoped **service-account** token is recommended for automation (see the BridgePort docs on Service Accounts). May also be set with the `BRIDGEPORT_TOKEN` environment variable. Prefer the environment variable so the token never lands in Terraform state or configuration.

block.description: The BridgePort provider manages configuration on a [BridgePort](https://github.com/bridgeinpt/bridgeport) instance — environments, servers, and the resources layered on top of them — declaratively via its HTTP API. Runtime operations (deploys, restarts, rollbacks) remain imperative; the provider only manages desired configuration.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the environment was created.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name shown in the UI.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier for the environment.

name.description: The unique slug of the environment (its natural key), e.g. `production`.

ssh_configured.description: Whether an SSH key is configured for this environment.

block.description: Look up a single BridgePort environment by its natural key (`name`).

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the environment was created.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name shown in the UI.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier for the environment.

name.description: The unique slug of the environment (its natural key).

ssh_configured.description: Whether an SSH key is configured for this environment.

environments.description: All environments the token can see.

block.description: List all environments visible to the configured token.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the server was created.

environment.description: The name of the environment the server belongs to, e.g. `production`.

environment_id.description: Opaque identifier of the environment the server belongs to.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier for the server.

name.description: The unique name of the server within its environment (its natural key).

public_ip.description: The server's public IP address, or null if it has none.

status.description: Current runtime status of the server as reported by the platform.

block.description: Look up a single BridgePort server by its natural key (`environment` + `name`).

environment.description: If set, only return servers in this environment (by `name`). Omit to list servers across every environment the token can see.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the server was created.

environment_id.description: Opaque identifier of the environment the server belongs to.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier for the server.

name.description: The unique name of the server within its environment.

public_ip.description: The server's public IP address, or null if it has none.

status.description: Current runtime status of the server as reported by the platform.

block.description: List servers visible to the configured token, optionally filtered to a single environment.

container_image_id.description: Opaque identifier of the container image the service deploys.

container_name.description: Name of the running container (runtime, reference only).

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the service was created.

environment.description: The name of the environment that hosts the service's server, e.g. `production`.

environment_id.description: Opaque identifier of the environment the service belongs to.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier for the service.

image_tag.description: The container image tag the service is configured to run.

name.description: The unique name of the service on the server (its natural key).

server.description: The name of the server the service runs on.

server_id.description: Opaque identifier of the server the service runs on.

service_type_id.description: Opaque identifier of the service type, or null if the service has none.

status.description: Current runtime status of the service as reported by the platform (reference only).

block.description: Look up a single BridgePort service by its natural key (`environment` + `server` + `name`).

environment.description: If set, only return services in this environment (by `name`). Required when `server` is set, so the server can be resolved by name.

server.description: If set, only return services on this server (by `name`). Requires `environment` to also be set. Omit to list every service in the environment, or across all environments when `environment` is also omitted.

container_image_id.description: Opaque identifier of the container image the service deploys.

container_name.description: Name of the running container (runtime, reference only).

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the service was created.

environment_id.description: Opaque identifier of the environment the service belongs to.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier for the service.

image_tag.description: The container image tag the service is configured to run.

name.description: The unique name of the service on its server.

server_id.description: Opaque identifier of the server the service runs on.

service_type_id.description: Opaque identifier of the service type, or null if the service has none.

status.description: Current runtime status of the service (reference only).

block.description: List services visible to the configured token, optionally narrowed to an environment or a single server.
